summary: CR-030 Freshmarketer Webhook endpoint testing. Found and fixed 2 critical Pydantic model bugs that caused 422 on all real Freshmarketer payloads. After fixes all 15 tests pass (100%).

critical.issue: FreshmarketerBody.event_time was typed as Optional[int] — Freshmarketer sends ISO datetime string like '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z', causing 422. Fixed to Optional[Union[int, str]].

FreshmarketerEventDetails.list_id and contact_id were Optional[str] without coerce_numbers_to_str — Freshmarketer sends ints (e.g. 123), causing 422. Fixed by adding coerce_numbers_to_str=True to model_config.

minor.issue: FreshmarketerContact.mobile was Optional[str] without coerce — Freshmarketer may send int mobile in contact block. Fixed by adding coerce_numbers_to_str=True.

action_items: No further action required — all CR-030 issues were fixed in this iteration.
FYI: event_time, list_id, contact_id type fixes were applied to /app/backend/routers/pos.py (Freshmarketer model classes).
critical_code_review_comments: FreshmarketerBody.event_time typed as int will always reject real Freshmarketer payloads (they send ISO strings). Fixed.
FreshmarketerEventDetails list_id/contact_id typed as str without coerce rejected integer inputs from Freshmarketer. Fixed.
FreshmarketerContact mobile typed as str without coerce could reject integer mobile from contact block. Fixed.
seed_data_creation: Test webhook_logs entries created with TEST_ prefixed Body.id values during idempotency and event-filtering tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-030 POST /api/pos/webhook fully tested and working. 3 Pydantic model fixes applied in pos.py for Freshmarketer model classes. All 15 tests pass. Regression: /api/pos/send and /api/pos/templates still pass. AUTHKEY_WID_MISSING confirmed as expected response for pos_0001_restaurant_689 user (no synced templates). Idempotency (status:replayed) works correctly.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: Freshmarketer sends event_time as ISO datetime string and event_details.list_id/contact_id as integers, but the Pydantic models declared these as Optional[int] and Optional[str] respectively without type coercion. This caused a 422 Unprocessable Entity on every real Freshmarketer webhook call, making the entire CR-030 feature non-functional in production. Fix: widened event_time to Union[int, str] and added coerce_numbers_to_str=True to FreshmarketerEventDetails and FreshmarketerContact model configs.
